events.title: Heist crew assembles
events.description: Elin recruits the crew at the Dockside tavern.

events.title: Chancellor commissions the vault
events.description: The Chancellor orders a new clockwork vault to protect the ledger.

events.title: Elin and Cato meet again
events.description: A tense reunion at the safehouse.

events.title: First reconnaissance of the vault
events.description: The crew scouts the Chancellor's tower.

events.title: Spy reports the crew's interest
events.description: The Chancellor's informant raises the alarm.

events.title: An old promise resurfaces
events.description: Cato reminds Elin of a debt owed.

events.title: The heist
events.description: The crew breaks into the vault.

events.title: Guards ambush the crew
events.description: The Chancellor springs the trap he set.

events.title: Cato's sacrifice
events.description: Cato holds the guards off so Elin can escape.

events.title: Escape into the canals
events.description: Elin flees with the ledger, crew scattered.
